node.statement: Extended th_main_ext assembly: there are universal C_E < infinity and epsilon_E > 0 such that every finite-dimensional extended epsilon-C*-algebra A, for 0 <= epsilon <= epsilon_E, is carried by one extended C_E*epsilon-isomorphism v:B->A from a finite-dimensional C*-algebra, with constants independent of dimension, amplification level, and block data.
